recentItems.title: Robbie Williams & Miss Monique - Beauty In Us (Tomorrowland Preview)
recentItems.description:
Our very special musical collaboration inspired by our different but equally defining experiences of electronic music and clubbing in Stoke-on-Trent and Kyiv… from the 90s to the 2010s.

It feels right for now… ‘Beauty In Us’ is coming soon…

Premiered at Tomorrowland Main Stage yesterday to 50,000 of you…

“Leave a light on… There’s still Beauty In Us…” 💚

Miss Monique and Robbie Williams
